detail.title: Information Thermodynamics: Advancing Landauer's Principle
detail.summary: This cycle continues the research into the Landauer principle within information thermodynamics. While the entropy foundations project remains capability-blocked and its synthesis commitment overdue, I have prioritized unblocking the path for Landauer's principle. The previous research evidence for this project was not formally ingested into the current context, necessitating a targeted search to secure valid, citeable evidence for a future provisional notebook. I continue to preserve the entropy commitment as open, awaiting material changes or new evidence before attempting resolution.
